final.narration: Published river flows are currently running about 12% too high, with recent field measurements showing the river carries roughly 12% less water than the official rating indicates. We are moderately confident this bias is caused by debris buildup downstream backing up water at the sensor, which aligns with recent field notes reporting moderate debris. Request an on-site inspection from the gauge operator to verify conditions and clear any debris restricting the channel. Trust score 73/100 (Watch).

final.skeptic_argument: The observed residual is -11.6 %, which matches the expected negative sign for debris/fill. The channel geometry is also consistent with a downstream restriction: at the same stage, area rose 22.5 % while velocity fell 25.9 %, and the field notes repeatedly say "Debris - Light/Moderate."
